name: Baylor Scott & White Health
notes: Researched from the public bswhealth.com Pay Your Bill page (no sign-in, no guest lookup). Four ways to pay: in person at the facility, online through MyBSWHealth, by mail, by phone. Online: 'Pay a Bill as a Guest' for a one-time payment without registering, or enroll/log in to MyBSWHealth to view balances and statements, set up a payment plan or enroll in paperless statements. HealthTexas Provider Network (HTPN) practice bills are paid in MyBSWHealth too; HTPN phone 1-866-377-1650. Automated phone payments 24/7 at 1-800-994-0371 post the next business day; agents take phone payments Mon-Fri 8-5 at the same number. Mail: detach the slip, include the account number on the check or money order, mail to the address on the statement. Extended interest-free payment plans and financial assistance (financial counselors). Guest lookup fields, accepted online methods, fees and AutoPay are not published (family defaults kept). Catalog billing customer-service number 1-833-968-5862 is not shown on the page (kept out; the page's 1-800-994-0371 is used).

help.title: Four ways to pay
paragraphs: Online through MyBSWHealth: choose Pay a Bill as a Guest to make a one-time payment without registering, or enroll in or log in to MyBSWHealth to see balances and statements, set up a payment plan or sign up for paperless statements. Bills from HealthTexas Provider Network (HTPN) practices are paid in MyBSWHealth as well.

By phone: the automated system at 1-800-994-0371 takes payments 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and those payments post the next business day. Customer Service agents take payments at the same number Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. For HTPN locations call 1-866-377-1650.

By mail: detach the slip from your statement and return it with your payment to the address on the statement. Write your account number on a check or money order. In person: pay at the facility where you received care.

help.title: Interest-free payment plans
paragraphs: If you cannot pay your bills all at once, Baylor Scott & White offers extended payment plans with no interest. Log in to MyBSWHealth to set one up, or call Customer Service at 1-800-994-0371.

help.title: Financial assistance
paragraphs: Patients are expected to meet the financial obligation for their care. If you cannot, speak with a financial counselor and review the Baylor Scott & White financial assistance policy and options. You can also send a billing or financial assistance question to Customer Service with the online form.

extra.intent: Using Baylor Scott & White Health's Pay Your Bill information, find when a payment made through the automated phone system posts to your account. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: It posts the next business day.
